title: Prior-art scout: the 27 VEV, rank-1 elements of J3(O), and where a direction could come from

q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.prior_panel_claim: rank-1 elements form OP^2 (dim 16), are the primitive idempotents; stabilizer in E6 is Spin(10), not SO(10)xU(1)
q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.verdict: CORRECT, with one precision correction about vector-vs-line

rank1_characterisations.intrinsic_sharp_map: a != 0 and a# = a x a = 0 (Freudenthal); the sharp/adjoint map is the polarisation of the cubic form
rank1_characterisations.idempotent: trace-1 projections; Baez proves rank(p) = tr(p) for every projection in h3(O)
rank1_characterisations.explicit: p = v v* with v = (x,y,z) in O^3, (xy)z = x(yz), and |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|^2 = 1
rank1_characterisations.note: the rank-1 condition is projective; tr(p)=1 is a choice of scale, not part of the geometry

space_of_rank1_elements.real_albert_algebra: OP^2, the octonionic (Cayley) projective plane, smooth manifold of real dimension 16
space_of_rank1_elements.complexified_27: the complex Cayley plane E6/P1, complex dimension 16, the UNIQUE CLOSED ORBIT of E6 on P(27); one of Zak's four Severi varieties
space_of_rank1_elements.cone: the punctured rank-1 cone has dimension 17 = 16 + 1

stabilizers.note: THE PHYSICALLY RELEVANT ONE - a VEV has a magnitude

q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.why_spin10_not_so10_u1: Under E6 > SO(10)xU(1)_psi, 27 = 1_4 + 10_-2 + 16_1. The rank-1 (highest weight) direction is the 1_4, carrying U(1)_psi charge 4 != 0, so the U(1) is BROKEN. Dimension check: 78-45 = 33 = 32 (spinor S_10) + 1 (broken U(1)).
q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.why_spin_not_so: the unbroken group acts on the 16 inside the 27, a genuine spinor representation, which SO(10) does not represent
q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.precision_correction: SO(10)xU(1) is not simply wrong - it is the stabiliser of the rank-1 LINE, i.e. the direction with magnitude forgotten. The difference is exactly the quotient by scale.
q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.trap_recorded: Baez writes 'the group of collineations fixing a specific point is Spin(9,1)'. This is the Levi's semisimple part, NOT the full isotropy group: 78-16 = 62, whereas dim Spin(9,1) = 45. The full point stabiliser is the parabolic (Spin(9,1) x R+) semidirect R^16, dim 62. Do not quote it as the stabiliser.

orbit_stratification_of_27.source: Ferrara-Gunaydin hep-th/9708025 section 2, LaTeX source read
orbit_stratification_of_27.count: exactly THREE nonzero orbits, labelled by Jordan rank
orbit_stratification_of_27.structural_consequence: The generic (open, full-measure) stratum has stabiliser F4 - which is exactly the programme's already-proved chirality-killing obstruction. Chirality survives ONLY on the closed, minimal, measure-zero rank-1 orbit. The F4 obstruction is not a separate fact; it is what the GENERIC VEV does.

q1_rank1_and_stabilizer.confidence: high - verified against primary LaTeX source of Baez (arXiv:math/0105155) and Ferrara-Gunaydin (hep-th/9708025); all dimension identities re-derived in-sandbox

q2_vev_direction_is_input_or_derived.verdict: INPUT, in every framework found. Nothing derives it.
q2_vev_direction_is_input_or_derived.refinement: Part of the problem genuinely IS derived and this should not be dismissed: the finite MENU of candidate directions (the orbit stratification and its little groups) follows from pure group theory with no potential and no parameters. What is never derived is which item on the menu is realised.

what_is_derived.the_menu: the orbit space / stratification of the 27 under E6 - three rank-labelled strata with fixed little groups
sources: Ferrara-Gunaydin hep-th/9708025 (explicit orbit table, source read)
J.S. Kim, J.Math.Phys. 25 (1984) 1694, INSPIRE 13825 - orbit spaces of the defining representations of F4 and E6; minima forced toward higher-little-group boundary strata (ABSTRACT ONLY)
Kim & Gell-Mann, INSPIRE 178410 - Michel-Radicati conjecture (ABSTRACT ONLY)
what_is_derived.limit: Michel-type geometry constrains the menu; it does not order off it. Which stratum is the global minimum depends on the potential's free parameters.

what_is_always_input.evidence: King-Moretti-Nevzorov hep-ph/0510419, full text read: 'Without loss of generality we can assume that only the third family Higgs doublets and singlets ... gain VEVs' - an assumption, justified only post hoc by a radiative mechanism

what_is_always_input.role: CONSTRAIN the admissible directions; never single one out
what_is_always_input.evidence: Callaghan-King 1210.6913, full text read: flatness imposed while free integer choices remain ('we leave n31>0 unspecified for now')

what_is_always_input.role: trades a continuous choice for an equally hand-picked DISCRETE choice
what_is_always_input.evidence: Hebecker-March-Russell hep-ph/0107039 proves orbifold breaking is 1-to-1 with Wilson-line breaking; the automorphism is selected to reproduce the SM

what_is_always_input.role: same paradigm, not an exception - fixed by minimising an effective potential from explicit-breaking terms

q2_vev_direction_is_input_or_derived.load_bearing_conclusion: No E6 framework derives the 27 VEV direction. Therefore the object 'not supplying a VEV' is NOT a defect peculiar to this object - it is the universal situation. The honest framing is not 'we lack an ingredient others have' but 'nobody has this ingredient'.
q2_vev_direction_is_input_or_derived.sharpening_from_q4: Within a single orbit all directions are E6-equivalent, so choosing a direction WITHIN a stratum is physically vacuous (pure gauge). The only meaningful content in 'choosing a VEV' is choosing WHICH RANK - a choice among three, not a choice in a 27-dimensional space.
q2_vev_direction_is_input_or_derived.confidence: high for the 'always an input' conclusion (two papers read in full); medium for the Michel/Kim derived-menu strand (abstract-level only, citation-trail confirmed)

q3_arithmetic_derivation_found.why_the_citing_set_is_instructive: The physics citers of Elkies-Gross are ALL black-hole charge-orbit / U-duality papers. There the 27 is a CHARGE vector, where integrality is physically forced by Dirac quantisation, so arithmetic structure is legitimate and used. In GUT model building the 27 is a HIGGS field whose VEV is a continuous parameter, and no one has proposed an integral structure on it. The arithmetic-27 idea exists in physics; it has never been applied to a VEV.

nearest.name: Flux / Wilson-line / orbifold GUT breaking
nearest.what_it_shows: genuine geometric/topological constraint on a symmetry-breaking direction; Donagi-Wijnholt show massless hypercharge is a topological constraint on the flux
nearest.why_it_fails_the_criterion: categorically NOT a Higgs VEV - no scalar acquires an expectation value in a representation. The breaking is a gauge-bundle/flux background (a class in H^{1,1} of a divisor). The direction fixed is WHICH CARTAN GENERATOR carries the flux, not a vector in a Higgs representation.
nearest.status: closest real analogue in physics; sidesteps the question rather than answering it

nearest.what_it_shows: arithmetically distinguished (CM) points genuinely singled out
nearest.why_it_fails_the_criterion: the distinguished points are in the COMPLEX-STRUCTURE MODULI SPACE of the Calabi-Yau, not in a representation space where a Higgs lives. Citing set filtered for Higgs/VEV terms (20 inspected); none extend the mechanism to a gauge-breaking direction.

nearest.name: The integral Albert algebra
nearest.what_it_shows: real, rich arithmetic structure on exactly the right object - integral structures on J3(O), the exceptional cone, integral/rational orbit classifications
nearest.why_it_fails_the_criterion: ZERO physics content - no GUT, no Higgs, no vacuum, no symmetry breaking. The mathematics exists; the bridge does not.

off_target_do_not_mistake_for_prior_art: 1604.01247 Dubois-Violette and 2006.16265 Boyle use J3(O) to encode fermion REPRESENTATION CONTENT via triality; neither addresses a Higgs mechanism or a VEV direction
Cayley-plane appearances in physics (0807.4899, 1006.0728, 2202.02050, 2309.00967) are target-space / index-theory objects, never vacuum-selection spaces
q3_arithmetic_derivation_found.scope_of_the_null: Certified for the specific claim 'a GUT Higgs VEV direction derived from arithmetic'. NOT a certification that the broader idea is impossible or that no adjacent work exists under entirely different vocabulary.

q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.transitivity_statement: OP^2 = F4 / Spin(9), with dim F4 = dim Spin(9) + dim OP^2 = 36 + 16 = 52
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.verification: Baez section 4.2, verbatim: Spin(9) is PRECISELY the subgroup of F4 = Aut(h3(O)) fixing the trace-1 projection diag(1,0,0), and F4 acts transitively on OP^2. Transitivity is CONSTRUCTED, not asserted: Baez section 3.4 gives an explicit algorithm (Spin(9) to make one octonion entry real, Spin(8) for the others, O(3) conjugation to diagonalise).
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.independent_confirmation: Miyasaka & Yokota arXiv:1011.0603 - 'any element X of the exceptional Jordan algebra J is transformed to a diagonal form by the compact exceptional Lie group F4', with a direct CONSTRUCTIVE proof replacing the earlier proof by contradiction
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.stronger_statement_the_seat_should_use: F4 acts transitively on ordered triples of pairwise-orthogonal primitive idempotents (JORDAN FRAMES), not merely on single idempotents. Equivalently E6 acts transitively on the punctured rank-1 cone. Consequently NO rank-1 element, NO orthogonal pair, and NO orthogonal triple is canonical.
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.why_the_stronger_statement_matters: The route identified by the prior panel needs TWO VEVs. Frame-transitivity closes the obvious escape hatch - 'maybe the PAIR is canonical even if neither element is'. It is not.
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.clean_structural_statement: The set of possible VEV directions is a HOMOGENEOUS SPACE of the symmetry group. A canonical point of a homogeneous space exists only if the space is a point. OP^2 has dimension 16. Therefore choosing a VEV direction is exactly and unavoidably a choice, and no symmetry-based argument can ever make it canonical.
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.value_of_this_result: It is not a negative about the object - it is a theorem about E6 that applies to every E6 model ever written. It converts 'our object fails to supply a VEV' into 'no group-theoretic structure can supply one; the question is misposed'.
q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.precise_scope: This forbids deriving the direction FROM THE SYMMETRY. It does not forbid deriving it from extra structure that BREAKS the homogeneity.

the_exception_arithmetic.statement: Homogeneity is a statement over R or C. Over Z or a number field the relevant group is ARITHMETIC, not the full real/complex group, homogeneity FAILS, and there are finitely many orbits labelled by genuine arithmetic invariants.

evidence.shows: an integral structure (J,E) on the 27-dim exceptional Jordan algebra; the cone of rank-1 elements tied to Leech/Niemeier lattices
embeddings of totally-real cubic rings into the integral Albert algebra
integral Freudenthal construction; algorithmic approach to ORBIT SPACES over Z; related to Bhargava's higher composition laws

SHARPEST LEAD - for the prehomogeneous space (GE6 x GL(2), J + J), i.e. literally PAIRS OF 27s, generic RATIONAL orbits are in bijection with pairs (M, n) where M is an isotope of J and n a cubic etale subalgebra; for split O, with separable extensions of k of degree <= 3. So over a non-closed field the configuration space of two 27s is NOT homogeneous.

the_exception_arithmetic.honest_limit: Choosing the integral structure is itself a choice; nothing found singles out ONE rank-1 element as canonical; and NO source connects any of this to a Higgs VEV (the Q3 null restated from the mathematics side).
the_exception_arithmetic.status: The opening is REAL and UNWORKED, not a result. It is also the one place where this object could differ from a generic E6 model, since it carries arithmetic (Q(sqrt(-3))) that a generic model does not. This is a motivation for a computation, NOT a claim, and must not be banked as one.

q4_OP2_homogeneous_under_F4.confidence: high - primary source read, plus an independent constructive proof

q5_no_gos.severity: DECISIVE - the prior panel did not flag this
q5_no_gos.claim: 27 VEVs can never break SU(5) -> the Standard Model
q5_no_gos.literature_statement: King-Moretti-Nevzorov hep-ph/0510419 section 2.2, verbatim (full text read): 'one cannot break E6 in a conventional manner as the required Higgs fields are in larger representations than the 27.' The authors resort to the Hosotani mechanism at the string scale for the primary breaking.

independent_rederivation_in_sandbox.key_fact: the 24 (adjoint of SU(5)) does NOT appear in the 27
independent_rederivation_in_sandbox.sharper_argument: Every component of 5, 5bar, 10 carries nonzero hypercharge. The ONLY Y-neutral directions available in any number of 27s are the SU(5) SINGLETS - and those break nothing inside SU(5). Hence no combination of 27 VEVs can break SU(5) -> SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)_Y. Any non-singlet direction that does break SU(5) necessarily also breaks U(1)_Y.
independent_rederivation_in_sandbox.worked_example: a VEV along the SU(3)xSU(2)-singlet (1,1) of the 10 leaves SU(3)xSU(2), rank 3 - hypercharge destroyed, not preserved

q5_no_gos.impact_on_the_prior_panel_route: The route is CORRECT as far as it goes: two rank-1 27 VEVs give E6 -> SO(10) -> SU(5), rank 6 -> 4, with the 27 still complex. But SU(5) is NOT the Standard Model, and the last step is blocked. The route delivers rank 4 + a complex 27 and then stops one step short, needing a 78 or 351 the 27 route does not contain.

q5_no_gos.severity: high - a genuine tension the seat must be able to explain
q5_no_gos.claim: In SUSY, D-flatness stalls the rank reduction at 5, not 4
q5_no_gos.evidence: hep-ph/0510419 (full text read): 27 VEVs come paired as 27_H + 27bar_H along the D-flat direction <N_H^c> = <Nbar_H^c>, breaking only ONE unit of rank. The E6SSM lands on a rank-5 group (SU(5)xU(1)_N or SO(10)xU(1)-type) and the final U(1)_N is broken separately at the TeV scale by an ordinary matter singlet S.
q5_no_gos.resolution_of_the_tension: Pure group theory says two rank-1 27 VEVs give SU(5), rank 4. The SUSY literature reports stalling at rank 5. These are CONSISTENT - the SUSY models impose D-flatness and CHOOSE directions preserving a U(1) (the E6SSM wants a TeV Z'). But a seat quoting 'two 27 VEVs give rank 4' inside a SUSY context will be contradicted by the literature and should know why.

q5_no_gos.severity: medium - unavoidable baggage of the representation
q5_no_gos.claim: Exotics, proton decay, and doublet-triplet splitting
details: (5bar,-3) and (5,-2): Higgs-doublet-like states PLUS a vector-like colour-triplet pair D, Dbar of charge -/+1/3, with B-L twice that of ordinary quarks
(1,5): extra singlet S; (1,0): right-handed neutrino N^c
matches 27 = 16 + 10 + 1 exactly; the exotics come with the representation and are unavoidable
q5_no_gos.proton_decay: hep-ph/0510419 states plainly that 'the gauge symmetry of the models under consideration does not forbid lepton and baryon number violating operators'. Suppression requires an AD HOC discrete symmetry (Z2^L -> exotics are diquarks; Z2^B -> exotics are leptoquarks), with some parameter regions 'basically ruled out'.
q5_no_gos.doublet_triplet: NOT solved, routed around: the D, Dbar triplets are kept LIGHT (TeV, vector-like mass from <S>) rather than split to the GUT scale. In the F-theory version (1210.6913) proton decay is suppressed by 'geometric coupling suppression ... peculiar to F-theory' - again a bypass, not a solution.

q5_no_gos.severity: structural - the cleanest statement of why two VEVs are forced
q5_no_gos.claim: A SINGLE 27 VEV cannot give both rank 4 and a complex 27
q5_no_gos.consequence: Rank 4 requires the generic strata, which give real F4/Spin(9); the complex-preserving stratum is the closed orbit, which stops at rank 5. Two rank-1 VEVs are therefore FORCED, not a modelling preference. This gives the prior panel's route an orbit-theoretic derivation rather than a bookkeeping observation.
q5_no_gos.reframing_of_the_programme_result: The programme's F4 chirality obstruction is not a separate fact - it is what the GENERIC VEV does. Chirality survives only on the closed, measure-zero rank-1 orbit, a codimension-10 condition in the 27.

what_the_seat_could_honestly_claim.claim: Rank-1 elements of J3(O) are exactly the primitive idempotents (trace-1 projections); projectively they form OP^2, dim 16; intrinsically a != 0 with a# = a x a = 0 (Freudenthal).
The stabiliser of a rank-1 VECTOR in compact E6 is Spin(10) (dim 45, orbit 33). The stabiliser of the rank-1 LINE is (Spin(10) x U(1))/Z_4. The prior panel is confirmed.
E6 has exactly THREE nonzero orbits on the 27, labelled by Jordan rank, with little groups F4 (rank 3), Spin(9)-type (rank 2), Spin(10)-type (rank 1).

OP^2 is F4-homogeneous (= F4/Spin(9)), and F4 is transitive on Jordan frames. Hence no rank-1 element, orthogonal pair, or triple is canonical over R or C. Choosing a VEV direction is exactly a choice with no canonical answer.

The programme's F4/chirality obstruction is the GENERIC stratum; chirality survives only on the closed, measure-zero rank-1 orbit. A single 27 VEV can never give both rank 4 and a complex 27 - hence two VEVs are FORCED.
27 VEVs cannot break SU(5) -> SM: the 24 is absent from the 27, and the only Y-neutral directions are SU(5) singlets, which break nothing.
In the E6 GUT literature the VEV direction is ALWAYS an input. So the object's failure to supply one is not peculiar to it.
Nobody has derived a GUT Higgs VEV direction from arithmetic (certified null, control passed, complete citation-graph closure on Elkies-Gross).
Two Jordan-rank-1 27 VEVs give SU(5) (rank 4, 27 complex) - BUT in a SUSY context D-flatness pairs 27/27bar and the literature stalls at rank 5; and SU(5) is not the SM.

Over Z or a number field the rank-1 elements are NOT homogeneous - arithmetic stratifies them (Elkies-Gross; Krutelevich; Kato-Yukie's classification of PAIRS of 27s by cubic etale algebras). This is the ONLY identified route to a distinguished direction, and it is unworked.

must_not_be_claimed: That the object's arithmetic DOES single out a rank-1 element. Nothing here shows that; the arithmetic opening is a motivation for a computation, not a result.
That deriving a VEV from arithmetic is 'novel' in the strong sense. The null is certified for the precise question asked; it is not proof that no adjacent work exists under other vocabulary.
That the two-27 route reaches the Standard Model. It reaches SU(5) and provably stops.
Anything sourced to 'Buccella-Ruegg-Savoy, Rank 5 and 6 subgroups of E6' or to a Babu-Bajc-Saad E6 paper - neither was located and they may not exist as described.
Baez's 'collineations fixing a point = Spin(9,1)' as a statement about the full stabiliser - it names the Levi's semisimple part; the full isotropy group is a 62-dimensional parabolic.
